blog.title: First log
blog.text: Today is a nice day. I get to take the day off, and I just finished creating the log feature for this website.
My hardened setup is now complete with BitWarden as my password manager.
I will continue working with Bevy and experimenting with SSR soon.
I didn't do much today. I also configured a couple of browser settings.
blog.em: Well, there goes my first log!
